note: Places where the toolchain knowingly differs from the specification.
An entry here is not an excuse: it is the record that the difference is
deliberate or understood. `ggc conform` fails on any difference that is
*not* in this file, and `ggc conform --strict` fails on these as well.
Each entry states what the specification says, what the toolchain does,
and -- where there is one -- the spelling that does work, which the
runner checks, so a deviation cannot rot into a false statement.

type-surface.reason: introduced by declaration (`record Point`) rather than used as a bare type name

    y : F64

fn takes(p: Point) -> Unit
    return
